acceptanceCriteria: RELEASE-RUNBOOK step 8 names the previous release as the first install and the new binary as CORVINT_LIFECYCLE_UPGRADE_BINARY, matching script/check-install-lifecycle.sh.
The step shows a runnable N-1 command.
body: Filed 2026-09-24 after the 0.8.0 release. docs/RELEASE-RUNBOOK.md step 8 tells the operator to set CORVINT_LIFECYCLE_UPGRADE_BINARY to the previous release's corvint. script/check-install-lifecycle.sh:18-22 defines it as the executable installed as the upgrade, so a real N-1 run puts the previous release in CORVINT_LIFECYCLE_BINARY (or _ARCHIVE) and the new binary in CORVINT_LIFECYCLE_UPGRADE_BINARY. The 0.8.0 N-1 runs used the script's meaning.

completion.reason: Fixed by beamfall/corvint#186, merged to main as a0632411.

title: docs: RELEASE-RUNBOOK step 8 says CORVINT_LIFECYCLE_UPGRADE_BINARY is the previous release; the script installs it as the upgrade
